typography.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-cyan-200

flow_architecture: 1. INTRO: Personal visually strong hero introducing Himesh Soni (3rd-year CS student at BITS Pilani Dubai Campus). integrated environmental layout, natural curiosity-driven copy.

2. WHAT I'M INTO: Interactive floating glass panels & environmental elements for areas (Computer Science, AI/ML, Systems/Architecture, Quantum Computing, Photography, Filmmaking). NO percentage skill bars.
3. WHAT I'M EXPLORING: Note cards, floating thoughts & papers presenting research questions ('Can noisy quantum channels be made more reliable?', etc.).

4. ROCKY SPACE SCENE: Scroll-driven Three.js animation with Rocky (glossy rock with eyes) + glossy spaceship leading user through stars, nebulae, & planets towards the COMPUTER with cinematic dialogue overlay.
5. COMPUTER: Auto-boot transition into Windows 7/Vista desktop world (Projects, Research, Photos, Resume, Contact apps inside Aero glass windows).

rocky_ai_chat.description: Floating AI assistant widget available in World 1 for users to ask questions about Himesh

testing_strategy.requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, links, dialogs, chat inputs) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 5-step flow specified by user: Intro -> What I'm into -> What I'm exploring -> Rocky space animation -> Computer.
Do NOT place Projects or Research as cards in World 1. Keep them inside the Computer desktop (World 2).
Ensure Windows Vista Aero glass style is applied to all desktop window frames (translucent glassy borders, soft blur, glowing cyan/blue title bars).
Include Rocky AI interactive chat widget accessible on World 1.
Provide responsive fallback for mobile scroll animations.
Ensure all clickable and key visual components have data-testid attributes.
